STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat plate, square-ish white plate with a rim band and flat centre, no inner wall visible.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plates are 20-30 cm; this one looks medium-large, about 25 cm across.
b) Reference: the corn cob slice is about 4-5 cm across, and the plate spans roughly 5-6 corn-slice diameters across the width, giving about 22-27 cm.
Reconciled width: about 25 cm (square, area about 625 cm²).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Pizza slice (one wedge, about 1/8 to 1/6 of a pizza): one slice is a countable standard piece, about 30 g for a bread-based slice of this size, but the topping looks heavy, so estimate about 80 g with cheese, sauce and meat/vegetable topping. Thickness about 1.5 cm.
- Chickpeas: about 45 visible pieces, plus some hidden in the pile. Chickpea about 0.3 g each cooked... more practically, the pile covers about 12% of the plate (about 75 cm²) at about 1.5 cm average thickness, so volume about 110 ml x 1.0 (cooked legume with dressing, approx.) ≈ 110 g.
- Mixed vegetables/onion and peppers in the pile (sautéed, with oil): part of the same pile, estimate 60 g.
- Mixed leaves (rocket/spinach, a small handful, lightly wilted): about 15 g of leaves; cooked weight about 20 g.
- Corn cob slice (cooked sweet corn, one round slice about 4.5 cm diameter, 2.5 cm thick): volume about 40 ml x 0.6 ≈ 25 g.
- Loose chickpeas on the plate (about 10 scattered, not in pile): about 10 g.

Hidden food: the chickpea pile sits on a light base of onion and sauté oil, already counted in the 60 g vegetable item.

Totals: pizza 80 g, chickpeas 120 g (110 + 10), sautéed vegetables 60 g, leaves 20 g, corn 25 g. Total about 305 g.

kcal per 100 g:
- Pizza slice: about 270 kcal/100 g.
- Chickpeas, cooked with oil: about 150 kcal/100 g.
- Sautéed vegetables with oil: about 90 kcal/100 g.
- Leaves: about 25 kcal/100 g.
- Sweet corn, cooked: about 96 kcal/100 g.

Energy estimate: pizza 216 + chickpeas 180 + vegetables 54 + leaves 5 + corn 24 ≈ 480 kcal.
